Synopsis:
    European equities declined on a global bond selloff, with STOXX 600 hitting a one-month low. Euro zone inflation above 3% (driven by energy costs) reinforced ECB rate hike expectations for the following week. Bond yields across Europe hit multi-year highs. Energy stocks outperformed on surging natural gas and crude prices ($92/bbl Brent), tied to US-Iran exchange of attacks. Fed Chair Kevin Warsh's hawkish commentary last week added upward pressure on global rate expectations. Notable movers: Novartis (+6.3% on MS drug trial success), Reckitt (+4.4% on favorable US lawsuit verdict), Partners Group (-7.3% on CEO departure and earnings warning).
